LanguageData.SSC_CorruptionGel.label: depravity gel
LanguageData.SSC_CorruptionGel.description: A gel that preserves fragments of pleasure, inducing euphoria when taken. Effects: greatly improves mood and slightly reduces work speed. Real orgasms can increase corruption, subject to the gel's cooldown and per-encounter limit. Total corruption is capped at 100%. Another dose refreshes duration. SSC masters are immune.
